description: Source code for ManagedIndexer class handling workspace folder indexing, git events, file upsert/delete, and search functionalities within a VSCode extension.

classes.name: ManagedIndexer
classes.description: Manages workspace folder indexing, git event handling, file synchronization with backend, and search within a VSCode extension.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of ManagedIndexer, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: onConfigurationChange
methods.description: Handles configuration updates, restarts indexing accordingly.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if managed indexing is enabled based on config and API state.

methods.name: sendStateToWebview
methods.description: Sends current indexer state to the webview UI.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes indexing process, sets up watchers, and loads workspace folder states.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, watchers, and listeners.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Fetches or reuses in-flight server manifest for a workspace folder state.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles git watcher events, triggers file processing.

methods.name: processFiles
methods.description: Processes files from git events, handles upsert and delete operations with backend.

methods.name: onDidChangeWorkspaceFolders
methods.description: Handles changes in workspace folders, restarts indexing.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs code search across indexed workspace folders.
